policy: Base art coverage does not complete dedicated customization art.
No category may be silently omitted. A family-appropriate equivalent or explicitly approved omission must be recorded.
Existing evidence and old 228-firearm coverage are retained, not reset or replaced. Requires reconciliation does not assert that no older artwork exists.
Partial candidate is not complete or approved. Each option and compatibility combination needs individual review.
Separate concept, implementation and native AoA plus TaCZ QA. No static artwork proves animation or gameplay.
Cosmetic channels cannot silently alter source damage, resource costs or target rules; functional conversions require separate explicit specification.
